1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned trial
court to decide the State Case No. 912 of 2009 (State Vs. Mahesh and others) arising out of Case
Crime No. 288 of 2007, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 469, 471, 409, 120B I.P.C. Police Station
Churkhi, District Jalaun, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Orai, District Jalaun,
expeditiously within a stipulated period.

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that although case is pending since 2008,
has failed to adduce entire evidence before the trial Court.
I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

sentences.text: It appears from the perusal of the order sheet that the case is pending at the stage of evidence.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to make all endeavours to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it, if there is no legal impediment.

8. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
